title: Board Prep: Signal Synthesis & Decision Agenda for Quarterly Roadmap Roundtable
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Synthesize cross-functional signals into a clear decision-focused agenda for the Q1 board/exec roundtable. Deliverables: one-page decision memo, prioritized trade-off table (cost/latency/impact), slide packet with 3 escalation asks, and an action tracker for post-readout follow-ups.
acceptance_criteria: One-page decision memo reviewed and signed-off by PM, Eng lead, and Design
Slide deck includes clear ask (resourcing, timeline, SLA) with numerical trade-offs
Risk heatmap and mitigation owners assigned
Action tracker created and linked to Linear issues for all follow-ups
comments: 2026-02-20 - Initial kickoff: aligned on audience (board + CTO + Head of Sales) and primary asks: Dedicated capacity commit and 1% unit-cost reduction target. Action: Diego to draft trade-off table.
2026-02-25 - Eng review (Ethan Park): flagged uncertainty in model quantization savings estimate; recommended conservative baseline plus a sensitivity band. Follow-up: run microbenchmarks (ENG-1842).
2026-02-28 - Design review (Lina Chen): suggested replacing two technical slides with a single visual showing routing/fallback flows to reduce cognitive load. Assigned two mockups to DES-98.
2026-03-02 - Finance input (Greg Thompson): requested per-customer unit-economics for top 10 accounts; provided spreadsheet link and asked for assumptions doc. Action: attach to Confluence page.

2026-03-05 - PM review (Asha Mehta): consolidated asks into 'S1: Dedicated commit for latency-critical customers' and 'S2: Invest in batching/kv cache tool to hit 1% cost down'. Added explicit fallback plan if commit not approved.
2026-03-07 - Draft deck posted: github PR for slides: https://github.com/redwood-inference/board-deck/pull/72 — reviewers: Maya Patel, Ethan Park, Lina Chen. Waiting on two PR comments about metrics.
2026-03-09 - Legal note (Securcom): requested statement on customer data residency for S1; security_review_required flagged. Action: add KMS/HSM slide with compliance owner.

2026-03-10 - Diego Ruiz: incorporated feedback, updated decision memo, and created follow-up Linear issues for each post-readout task (see linked_artifacts). Ready for final sign-off from Head of Product by 2026-03-12.
decision_log: 2026-03-03 - Decision: Present two asks (S1 and S2) rather than three to keep exec focus; rationale - limited board time and higher chance of approval for focused asks.
2026-03-06 - Trade-off stance: Use conservative cost-savings estimate (lower bound) but show sensitivity band to avoid over-promising.
2026-03-09 - Compliance inclusion: Add KMS/HSM slide and named owner (Security + Customer Success) to address residency concerns.
2026-03-10 - Escalation rule: If Dedicated commit is not approved, pivot to a 3-month pilot with telemetry gating and automatic revisit in Q2 review.
